coverage.evidence: AdNextHelpers.cs:21-59 and AdPastAndSnoozeHelpers.cs:19-46 define the 11 keys ad.next.in, ad.next.in.long, ad.next.at, ad.next.seconds, ad.next.duration, ad.isScheduled, ad.last.ago, ad.last.at, ad.snoozes.left, ad.snoozes.refreshIn, ad.prerollFree; all are BroadcastRow.Of with MinArgs=MaxArgs=0 (BroadcastRow.cs:29-35, 47-50), and the event keys are seeded values with no arguments (TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:221-245), so the page's 'None of the ad helpers take an input' holds.

BroadcastText.Brief rounds to the minute, gives seconds under a minute and gives 0s when the span is negative or zero (BroadcastText.cs:29-42); Words with precision 2 (AdNextHelpers.cs:31, BroadcastText.cs:45-46); Clock uses HH:mm in the channel zone, or UTC when the zone is unset (StreamText.cs:106-115); ad.next.duration uses StreamText.Short, e.g. 1m 30s (StreamText.cs:68-75); ad.snoozes.left uses PeopleText.Count N0 (PeopleText.cs:24); a moment of 0 or a null schedule returns null, so the token prints as typed (AdRows.cs:22-53); ad.isScheduled gives the true/false flag of NextAdAt>0, or null with no schedule (AdNextHelpers.cs:50-59, PeopleText.cs:21).

Schedule-reading ad rows carry TemplateHelperContexts.Standard (BroadcastRow.cs:53), which is every context except Viewer (TemplateHelperContexts.cs:21-22; enum TemplateHelperContext.cs:18-61: Command, EventResponse, Timer, Pipeline, Discord, Webhook); ad.duration, ad.when, ad.seconds and ad.automatic are EventSourceOnlyContexts (EventResponse and Pipeline) and event scoped (TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:102-106, 221-245).

The schedule helpers take no argument and read GetAdScheduleAsync once per render (AdData.cs:18-49); a failure, an exception or a missing channel:read:ads permission returns null, so the token prints as typed (BroadcastFetch.cs:31-43, TwitchAdsApi.cs:65-73); no planned break gives NextAdAt 0, so the time helpers print as typed and ad.isScheduled gives false (AdRows.cs:40-53, AdNextHelpers.cs:56-58); ad.next.duration is Over, not AtMoment, so it still prints Twitch's Duration (AdNextHelpers.cs:45-49).

Presets: channel.ad_break.begin seeds user, user.id, ad.duration and ad.automatic; channel.ad_break.end seeds ad.duration; channel.ad_break.upcoming seeds ad.when and ad.seconds (EventResponsePresetCatalog.cs:146-151); the upcoming warning fires once when 3 minutes or less are left, while live, skips a break in the first 10 minutes and needs channel:read:ads (AdScheduleWarner.cs:39-42, 122-123, 154-161, 237-257); ad.when wording is 'in ~N minutes', or seconds when under one minute (AdScheduleWarner.cs:261-267); ad.duration uses HumanDuration, whole minutes when the seconds divide evenly, else seconds (TwitchAlertHandlerBase.cs:141-150); user is empty for an automatic break (AdBreakBeganAlertHandler.cs:43-51); the end line runs after the break's length, only when still live on the same stream (AdBreakEndScheduler.cs:54-68, 101-121).

reader_answers.evidence: No argument on any ad row (BroadcastRow.cs:29-35); next-break keys exist (AdNextHelpers.cs:21-49); the if path form uses LogicArguments.IsTrue on the resolved value, so false, empty or unresolved runs the else text (IfTemplateHelpers.cs:130-157, LogicArguments.cs:31-35); ad.when is on Ad break coming and ad.duration is on Ad break ends (EventResponsePresetCatalog.cs:149-151); ad.last.ago and ad.last.at read the schedule (AdPastAndSnoozeHelpers.cs:19-30).

channel:read:ads is required (TwitchScopes.cs:24, TwitchAdsApi.cs:65-73); the grant is POST twitch/diagnostics/regrant behind twitch:diagnostics:read (TwitchDiagnosticsController.cs:107-110), which is the Mod tier (ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:51, 305); the notice and button are on Integrations (MissingTwitchScopesNotice.vue:28, 76-84; integrations/i18n/en.json:7-11); approval saves the token of the Twitch user who approves (AuthService.cs:300-336); until then the helpers print as typed and the warner skips (AdScheduleWarner.cs:154-161).

The approved title is common.regrant.approved, 'Permissions granted. Twitch now lets the bot use them.' (MissingTwitchScopesNotice.vue:41-53, i18n/locales/en.json:49); schedule rows are Standard contexts that fetch at render (BroadcastRow.cs:53, AdData.cs:25-32); event keys are EventSourceOnlyContexts (TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:102-106).

The upcoming chat warning goes out once per slot when 3 minutes or less are left (AdScheduleWarner.cs:237-257); ad.duration on channel.ad_break.end is the length of the break that just ended (AdBreakEndScheduler.cs:115-121); the end line runs only while live with the same WentLiveAt (AdBreakEndScheduler.cs:103-105).
